claims: The 2026 NHL playoffs are scheduled to begin on Saturday, April 18, 2026.
The 2026 NHL regular season concludes on April 16, 2026.
The 2026 NHL playoffs conclude no later than June 21, 2026.
2026 NHL playoff games will be broadcast on ESPN, NHL on TNT, Sportsnet, and TVA Sports.
As of April 13, 2026, teams including the Hurricanes, Sabres, Canadiens, Lightning, Penguins, Senators, Bruins, Avalanche, Stars, Wild, Mammoth, Oilers, and Golden Knights have secured playoff spots.
The NHL will announce the official first-round schedule, including game times, once all regular-season games are completed.
